# R&C Barbershop

> Barbershop at 798 Chambers St, Trenton, NJ 08611. Phone (609) 310-8842. Walk-ins welcome. English and Spanish spoken.

## Hours
- Monday–Wednesday: 9 AM – 7 PM
- Thursday–Saturday: 8 AM – 8 PM
- Sunday: 9 AM – 4 PM

## Services and prices (USD)
- Regular Haircut: $35 (30 min)
- Fade: $30 (35 min)
- Fade & Blowout: $30 (30 min)
- Haircut + Beard: $40 (40 min)
- Haircut + Eyebrows: $40 (40 min)
- Hair + Beard + Eyebrows: $45 (45 min)
- Kids Cut (10 and under): $30 (35 min)
- Veteran & Senior (62+) Haircut: $25 (30 min)
- Beard Trim: $20 (30 min)
- Shape Up: $20 (15 min)
- Beard Tint: $15 (15 min)
- Eyebrows: $10 (20 min)
- Hair Designs: from $10 (30 min)

## Team
- Raffy – Owner & Barber
- Yoquelk ("El Líder"), Christopher, Julio, Miguel, Roger, Tito – Barbers
